summary_en: Board authorized acquisition of up to 800,000 shares (1.28% of outstanding shares) for maximum 2.0 billion yen through market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, the Board of Directors of Techno Ryowa Ltd. authorized the acquisition of up to 800,000 treasury shares, representing 1.3% of the 62,042,076 outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum expenditure of 2.0 billion yen. The acquisition will be executed through market purchases, including ToSTNeT-3 transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, during the period from November 9, 2026 through March 31, 2027.

The company stated that the buyback program is designed to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns while enabling flexible capital management in response to changing business conditions. The authorization provides management with discretionary timing and pricing within the specified limits, allowing the company to deploy capital strategically over the six-month window.
